snippet.title: Frostland | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Frostland is coming May 18, 2026 to Steam.

Click, collect, build and craft. Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley. Gather and process resources to forge tools and help a young wizard dog on his journey.

Wishlist now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4568090/Frostland/

#cozygames #cozygaming #clickergame #indiegame #relaxinggame
